name: Como Castello del Nero
insider_take: This 12th-century castle turned luxury resort sits majestically in the Chianti hills, where medieval grandeur meets modern Italian elegance just 30 minutes from Florence's Renaissance treasures.
whats_special: The castle features original frescoed walls and vaulted ceilings, while its 740-acre estate produces award-winning Chianti Classico wine. The property's Michelin-starred restaurant showcases ingredients grown in the hotel's own organic gardens, and guests can enjoy private truffle hunting expeditions through the surrounding oak forests.
pro_tip: Book the exclusive "Sunrise Hot Air Balloon" experience over the Chianti countryside – it launches directly from the castle grounds and includes champagne breakfast upon landing.
dont_miss: The underground wine cellars dating back 800 years, where you can participate in private tastings of the estate's vintage collection. Also explore the castle's secret passageways and climb the ancient tower for panoramic views of the Tuscan hills and vineyards stretching to the horizon.
pros: Historic 12th-century castle transformed into luxury resort
Stunning Chianti countryside setting with panoramic Tuscan views
Michelin-starred dining with exceptional Italian cuisine
Prime location for exploring Florence and Tuscan wine regions
cons: Remote countryside location requires transportation to city centers
